def line(xs, y_drill):
    out = []
    for x in xs:
        try:
            move_to(Position(x=x, y=y_drill-3))
            d = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=Position(x=x, y=y_drill), direction=Direction.UP)
            f = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.ElectricFurnace, d.position, direction=Direction.UP, spacing=0)
            i = place_entity(Prototype.Inserter, position=Position(x=x, y=f.position.y-2), direction=Direction.UP)
            print("drill", d.position, d.drop_position, "furn", f.position, "ins", i.position, i.pickup_position, i.drop_position)
            out.append((d, f, i))
        except Exception as e:
            print("line err", x, e)
    return out
